To Li Tiegu, both Zhu Yousheng and Hong were the greatest heroes under heaven. So long as those two still stand, no Khitan raiders could ever be their match. 

But one day, Hong turned and walked away, becoming a traitor cursed by all. The rest were left behind, trapped like beasts in the Khitan cage. 

When his brothers-in-arms fell one by one to Khitans' blade, and that blood-drenched saber finally swung toward him,
Li Tiegu closed his eyes. 
He thought, whatever reasons Brother Hong had for leaving them, there's no going back.

Bei Xiaoyu knew that Hong never built the Unbound Cavern to oppose the Nine Mortal Ways. He only wanted a place for those like himself, unwanted, outcast, a place to belong. Though their hands were stained with blood, he still believed time would mend the wounds. 

But the day Guo Wei's army stormed the city, the Nine Mortal Ways' schemes cost Hong his parents. And everything changed. He changed his name to Hong Si, expanded the Unbound Cavern, and welcomed scoundrels from across the world. He vowed to wipe the Nine Mortal Ways from the earth. 

Later, Hong Si left Kaifeng with a pair of siblings. And the one who stayed behind, Bei Xiaoyu, could only watch as Unbound Cavern turned into a haven for monsters. When the thugs cast him into the waters to drown, desperation finally took root in his heart. 
He knew all too well, there would be no hope in Unbound Cavern from this moment on.
